corrected_claim: Tencent fell about 19% close-to-close over 14-15 Mar 2022 (reports cited 22%+ intraday; Hang Seng suffered its worst session in years, -13% intraday on 15 Mar). Market cap roughly halved over the prior year: ~US$880B peak (Feb 2021, ~HKD 678) to ~US$345B (Mar 2022, ~HKD 283); the '₹7 lakh crore → ₹3 lakh crore' figures do not match (likely garbled units). Infosys did not double in that single year: it rose ~37% (₹1,350→~₹1,850) over Mar 2021-Mar 2022 (it had tripled only from the COVID low of ~₹540).
